components.name: Bunting stage frame
components.description: A broad rounded overhead beam spans two tall straight side posts, with three triangular pennants hanging below the beam. Generate the empty stage enclosure and exclude the central microphone and stand.

components.name: Microphone on tripod stand
components.description: A circular microphone head sits on a short angled arm above a thin vertical stand with two spreading feet. Isolate the microphone and stand; exclude the overhead beam, posts and pennants.
